programme.title: Melody
programme.desc: 1971. Comedy. Directed by Waris Hussein. Stars Mark Lester, Tracy Hyde & Jack Wild. Two youngsters declare to their parents they want to get married as soon as possible. [S]

programme.title: It Happened Today
programme.desc: Made in 1947. A Road safety film by the West Riding Constabulary. Narrated by Patrick Holt.

programme.title: Honey West
programme.desc: 1965. An Eerie, Airy, Thing. Crime series produced by Aaron Spelling. Starring Anne Francis. A distraught man wants to see his wife before he dies of suicide.

programme.title: The Rogues
programme.desc: The Laughing Lady Of Luxor. 1965. Gig Young, David Niven and Charles Boyer are The Rogues, members of two related families of international forgers and conmen. [S]

programme.title: Cottage to Let
programme.desc: 1941. War. Director: Anthony Asquith. Stars Leslie Banks, Alastair Sim & John Mills. Nazi spies learn about a new device created by a British inventor and send an undercover agent to his cottage. [S]

programme.title: Doublecross
programme.desc: 1955. Drama. Director Anthony Squire. Stars Donald Houston, Fay Compton, William Hartnell. A Cornish poacher clashes with dangerous international spies. [S]

programme.title: Sea to Plate and Billingsgate
programme.desc: 1956. Documentary on the distribution of fish throughout England. From tower bridge at 6am at Billingsgate in the 1950s to all the little harbours around the coast and everything in between.

programme.title: Doctor at Sea
programme.desc: 1955. Comedy. Directed by Ralph Thomas. Stars Dirk Bogarde, Brigitte Bardot, James Robertson. A young man signs up to be a ship's doctor in an effort to bring some excitement into his life. [S]

programme.title: Four Star Playhouse: The Wallet
programme.desc: 1954. Drama. Directed by Robert Florey. Stars Charles Boyer & Maria Palmer. A waiter with more pride than money takes a wealthy customer's forgotten wallet to get his sick wife good medical care. [S]

programme.title: Railway Murders
programme.desc: The First Railway Murderer. 2021. Stars Nicholas Day, Matthew Green & Alan Moss. The first ever murder on a British train. 70 year old victim Thomas Briggs was murdered in 1864 by Franz Muller. [S]

programme.title: William Tell
programme.desc: The Trap. 1959. Stars: Conrad Phillips, Willoughby Goddard & Jennifer Jayne. By using a traitor planted in Tell's camp, Gessler plans to smash the resistance movement in one swoop. [S]

programme.title: The Dark Man
programme.desc: 1951. Drama. Director: Jeffrey Dell. Stars Maxwell Reed, Edward Underdown & Natasha Parry. An inspector hunts a killer who is looking for an actress who witnessed him commit murder. [S]

programme.title: Cinebox Memories
programme.desc: A spectacular performance of Up On The Roof in this wonderful musical video from the 60s.
